display.purpose: Article h1; also the 1.5rem type ceiling.

date.purpose: Diary entry dates only. The face is an open user decision; the stack is a placeholder.

metadata.purpose: Generic time, performer line, provider links.

label.purpose: Language link, intro sub-headings, English list dates.

signature.purpose: The author name beside the docked bottle.

motion.name: color-hover
motion.purpose: Control and mark color shift to ribbon red.

motion.name: key-press
motion.purpose: A pressed control sinks one pixel like a key.

motion.name: arrow-slide
motion.purpose: External-link arrow slides 2px up-right on hover.

motion.name: bottle-dock
motion.value: triggered past --dock-threshold (2rem) by a step-end scroll(root) flip of @property --docked; 550ms cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1) transition on translate/scale/rotate
motion.purpose: The home bottle photo turns, leans, shrinks and darkens into a solid masked silhouette as the logo, ending at the :root logo variables (--logo-top 16px, --logo-left -4px from the shell edge, --logo-rotate -3deg, --logo-width 22px; set by the user) that the page-header logo shares. Longhands only.

motion.name: platen-rise
motion.value: opacity follows --docked, transitioned with the dock
motion.purpose: Paper band fades in once the mark is docked.

components.name: Bracket Control
components.description: Every control is a struck [ label ] with ribbon-red brackets; hover turns the label red, press sinks 1px.
components.css: .ds-bracket { display: inline-flex; gap: 0.5ch; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; color: var(--ink, #141414); font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "PingFang TC", "Noto Sans TC", monospace; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; text-decoration: none; transition: color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-bracket::before { color: var(--ribbon, #c4161c); content: "["; } .ds-bracket::after { color: var(--ribbon, #c4161c); content: "]"; } .ds-bracket:hover { color: var(--ribbon, #c4161c); } .ds-bracket:active { translate: 0 1px; } .ds-bracket:focus-visible { outline: 1px dashed var(--ink, #141414); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Language Link
components.description: The only navigation: a muted bracket control in the header.
components.css: .ds-lang { display: inline-flex; gap: 0.5ch; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; color: var(--ink-muted, #5f5f5f); font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "PingFang TC", "Noto Sans TC", monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; transition: color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-lang::before { color: var(--ribbon, #c4161c); content: "["; } .ds-lang::after { color: var(--ribbon, #c4161c); content: "]"; } .ds-lang:hover { color: var(--ribbon, #c4161c); } .ds-lang:active { translate: 0 1px; } .ds-lang:focus-visible { outline: 1px dashed var(--ink, #141414); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Diary Entry
components.description: A handwritten date heads clamped typed text in a single column.
components.html:
11月 8日

今天把瓶子上了第一層釉。
components.css: .ds-entry { display: grid; gap: 0.75rem; color: var(--ink, #141414); font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "PingFang TC", "Noto Sans TC", monospace; } .ds-date { margin: 0; font-family: "Diary Date", "Bradley Hand", "Noteworthy", "Segoe Print", "Ink Free", casual, cursive; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-text { font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.75; } .ds-text p { margin: 0 0 0.75em; }

components.name: English Plain List Row
components.description: A frameless 2.75rem row with a title link and small date; hover turns the title ribbon red.
components.css: .ds-list { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color: var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 2ch; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.25rem 0; } .ds-row a { color: inherit; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.2; text-decoration: none; } .ds-row:hover a { color: var(--ribbon, #c4161c); } .ds-row time { color: var(--ink-muted, #5f5f5f); font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.2; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.overview:
The pottery diary is typed out like a proof pulled on a typewriter: pure white paper, black ink, one red ribbon, and a single monospace cell that everything sits on. Photographs are shown plainly; the type does the shaping. The page never decorates; it types.

Hierarchy comes from the cell grid, not from size. Controls are struck as [ label ] brackets whose brackets carry the red. The dates are the only handwriting on the page. The world refuses the soft-paper journal and the photo-grid portfolio.
keyCharacteristics: Pure white paper (#ffffff) with near-black ink (#141414); red ribbon (#c4161c) is the only chromatic ink.
One monospace stack for every typed cell; the only webfont is a self-hosted digits-and-slash subset for the dates.
All text starts flush on the column edge; only control brackets hang one cell into the margin.
Photographs appear as they are; the only image treatment is the bottle hero docking into a solid silhouette.
Flat everywhere: no shadows, no radii, no fills; depth is only the platen band and the lightbox veil.

rules.name: The Single Ribbon Rule
rules.body: Red is struck only as a mark: brackets, hover, selection, link underline. It never fills a block or sets paragraph text.

rules.name: The White Paper Rule
rules.body: The paper is pure white; do not tint it. Every veil, backing, and band uses the same paper value.

rules.name: The One Cell Rule
rules.body: Everything typed uses the single monospace stack; text widths are measured in ch (measures 64ch and 70ch).

rules.name: The Handwritten Date Rule
rules.body: Only dates take --diary-date-font. No other element may borrow it.

rules.name: The One Subset Rule
rules.body: System faces everywhere except the dates' handwriting, which ships as one same-origin digits-and-slash subset under 4 KB. A test enforces exactly that one @font-face.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: No shadows, glass, blur, or gradients. Depth is paper over text, nothing more.

dos: Do set everything in the one monospace stack at weight 400, with hierarchy from scale, ink tone, and grid position.
Do start all text flush on the column edge; entries carry no index.
Do strike controls as [ label ] with ribbon-red brackets and a 1px press sink.
Do write scroll-driven animations as longhands and gate them on @supports and prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
Do keep zero runtime JS on content pages; only posts load the likes script.
Do keep type at or below 1.5rem.
donts: Don't use --diary-date-font for anything but dates.
Don't add any other @font-face or webfont; Chinese webfonts are megabytes.
Don't add shadows, border radii, glass, blur, fills, or card frames.
Don't fill with ribbon red or set paragraph text in it.
Don't tint the paper away from pure white.
Don't write animation: shorthand with a timeline.
Don't treat the handwriting face as chosen, or Chinese as grid-aligned; both are open (see Typography).
